title: Expanded Potions
description: Adds 15 new potions with vanilla effects for survival mode: haste, levitation, luck, blindness, saturation, and more!
body:
This mod/datapack adds **15 new potions** with **vanilla effects** for survival mode!

![A chest containing all the new potions and their ingredients](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qsBLAPZy/images/01d65f60cfe2487182c9f27cb2ce82651fbf7767.png)

Here is the list of new potions along with how to brew them:
- Awkward Potion + **Golden Apple** -> Potion of **Absorption**
- Awkward Potion + **Poisonous Potato** -> Potion of **Bad Luck**
- Awkward Potion + **Echo Shard** -> Potion of **Blindness**
- Awkward Potion + **Nautilus Shell** -> Potion of **Breath** (Gives the Breath of the Nautilus effect)
- Awkward Potion + **Sculk** -> Potion of **Darkness**
- Awkward Potion + **Spectral Arrow** -> Potion of **Glowing**
- Awkward Potion + **Iron Pickaxe** -> Potion of **Haste**
- Awkward Potion + **Enchanted Golden Apple** -> Potion of **Health Boost**
- Awkward Potion + **Rotten Flesh** -> Potion of **Hunger**
- Awkward Potion + **Shulker Shell** -> Potion of **Levitation**
- Awkward Potion + **Heart of the Sea** -> Potion of **Luck**
- Awkward Potion + **Prismarine Shard** -> Potion of **Mining Fatigue**
- Awkward Potion + **Brown Mushroom** -> Potion of **Nausea**
- Awkward Potion + **Cake** -> Potion of **Saturation**
- Awkward Potion + **Wither Rose** -> Potion of **Withering** (Gives the Wither effect)

> **Note:**
> Due to the way Mojang has implemented potion brewing recipes in datapacks, it is **currently impossible** to add glowstone dust, redstone, gunpowder, or dragon breath to a custom potion to increase its amplifier, make it last longer, make it a splash potion, or make it a lingering potion, respectively. If Mojang changes this, I'll update the pack with the new features.
> 
> Due to this, these custom potions **cannot be made stronger or longer**.
> 
> If you wish to make a **splash/lingering variant**, brew a **splash/lingering awkward potion first**, then add the custom ingredient.
